∀ {p r : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ) (σ : ℝ) (x : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
  ∑ α,

passages.claim: The actual nuclear sum is bounded using the proved projected-mean reduction, common-angle outer entropy, actual positive moments and signed aggregate trace. The three constants are fixed from actual geometric/coarea theorems and absorbed into a single model-independent power K+3.
passages.method_variation: Lean K counts additional labels, so its length K+2 and exponent K+3 agree with printed total length K and exponent K+1. The signed trace is retained through the binomial restoration before its absolute value is bounded. The reference mass uses the disclosed direct independent-normal profile integration, rather than an annular density partition; all quantitative conclusions and exact one-half score integral are separately checked.

passages.claim: The complete actual pair proposition holds for arbitrary rectangular factors with unit row Gram diagonal, arbitrary singular physical base law satisfying actual intrinsic concentration, every nonnegative number of additional labels, and every deterministic threshold shift. Its constant is fixed before all model data and is at least four.
passages.method_variation: The final premises contain only actual law, factor, concentration and bandwidth data. There is no surface, coarea, entropy, mean, trace, restoration or matrix supplier premise. Parallel and repeated normals contribute zero angle and are allowed. The proof establishes the stronger range σ>0 without needing σ≤1. The separate first-pair restriction/gap division is supplied by the already checked Supplemental I restriction and HFourthPairIndexTransport routes.
